E.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Joe Jimenez, Recreation and Community Services Director, provided summer programming updates:
summer lunch program has completed; camp had 165 signups; pool will remain open until Labor Day
weekend; registration is open for volleyball and flag football; the last summer concert series is
September 18, announced the deadline of August 31 to reserve the graduation banner; and announced
a free soccer clinic for youth on August 19.

Steve Gomez, Public Safety Director, announced that today was the first day of school, and that public
safety was patrolling the schools to ensure safety.

Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, provided an update on the business license tax revenue measure.

F.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

G.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Mayor Pro Tem Roa asked about a mid­budget review.

Mayor Del Rio thanked staff for a great National Night Out event; and asked about the possibility of
graduation banner options for non­Hawaiian Gardens residents.

H.  CLOSED SESSION

There were no Closed Session items.

I.  ADJOURNMENT

The City Council adjourned the meeting at 8:12 PM to the next Regular City Council meeting to be held
on Wednesday, August 26, 2026 at 6:00 PM.
